text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, have you heard? That urban legend 
everyone's been talking about lately!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I heard, I heard! A mysterious Umamusume 
chasing you from inside the screen!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Once you lock eyes with her on the 
screen, even if you change the channel, 
you'll still see her... right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tilting my head at the conversation 
echoing from the hallway, I turned on the 
TV to check the weather—

text_block_list.name: Weather Forecaster
text_block_list.text:
Today and tomorrow in central Tokyo, it 
should be clear skies all day! You can 
hang your laundry outside without worry.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Exquisite ramen rich with seafood broth! 
It's delicious enough to justify the long 
line!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Round eyes staring this way from the edge 
of the screen. The true identity of this 
urban legend might just be...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, did Ma-chan just get treated like 
an urban legend?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I cannot let that slide. Machan is a cute 
mascot. Being treated like an apparition 
is rather unacceptable.
choice_data_list:
Why were you trying to get on TV in the 
first place?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In short, it's part of the promotional 
activities.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Ma-chan can instantly sense wherever 
people's eyes are gathering."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Going there to photobomb the scene, 
gradually slipping into everyone's view so 
they'll remember me..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's Operation Subliminal Marchan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Is what I was thinking, but... hmm. This 
situation might be a little different.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"That Rumored Umamusume" showed up 
again...! Apparently the girl who saw her 
has spotted her a week in a row now!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Whisper, whisper, mumble, mumble, 
mumble...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really!? Does that mean... wait, 
she's not here?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So that's what was going on! Phew, what a 
relief...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's even become a rumor in class... I'll 
be sure to tell everyone too!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Alright, nice to meet you.
choice_data_list:
What have you two been talking about all 
this time?

What have you two been talking about all 
this time?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Nfufufu. Now, now, no need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
And so, they say seeing them brings a 
little good luck... Isn't this basically a 
modern-day Zashiki-warashi!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? In that case, I kinda want to go look 
for it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, it's easy to get on daytime 
TV shows. Rumor has it that it even looks 
like our uniform."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I see. This looks good to go.
choice_data_list:
Did they seem pretty used to dealing with 
this...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Do you think so? ...Perhaps you're right.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mascots can be interpreted in all sorts of 
ways. It makes me happy if that brings 
fans joy, but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Ma-chan wants to be seen as pretty, so 
Ma-chan will make a slight course 
correction."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Turns out the rumors about that mystery 
Umamusume aren't bad after all?" 
"Apparently good things happen?" "Then 
let's go check it out."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now that she recognizes me... behold! 
Turns out that Umamusume is called Machan! 
She remembers me perfectly, and all's well 
that ends well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...So because of that, I plan to keep 
working hard on my 'photobombing' going 
forward.
choice_data_list:
Moving swiftly might make for good 
training...?

You're really good at coming up with 
strategies!

You're really good at coming up with 
strategies!

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's one way to look at it. 
Consider Chan's eyes thoroughly opened.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm so glad your Trainer is so 
understanding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was elusive and airy, but this 
incident made me realize just how many 
deep thoughts were swirling inside her 
head...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. It's an essential skill for a 
world-class mascot, after all.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No plan at all is a no-thank-you, but 
overplanning is total nonsense too. Let's 
just keep it chill and take it easy~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was elusive and airy, but this 
incident made me realize just how many 
deep thoughts were swirling inside her 
head...
